mission_09: Event delegation: container.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target.closest('.delete-btn')) { ... } }). Use data attributes to identify actions.
EventEmitter stores callbacks in an object keyed by event name. on() pushes to the array, emit() iterates and calls each callback.
For drag and drop, set draggable.draggable = true, listen for dragstart on the source and dragover/drop on the target. Call e.preventDefault() on dragover.
